units: all clock values microseconds; RTP 90 kHz modulo 2^32

stateDefinitions.unavailable: no usable timing point; legacy fallback required

oracle: targets preserve source intervals independent of arrival jitter; --arrival-only must fail this same oracle

cases.description: Sub-ms fractional credit funds a 1 us step; unfunded correction remains queued until the next funded update, with no re-warm.

expectedFields: state/targetUs/sourceUs/reserveUs/reason are checked when present; optional epoch verifies that re-warm invalidates previous metadata.

seriesGrammar.truth: anchorBaseUs + trunc(sourceUs*driftPpm/1000000) + (stepAtFrame > 0 and frame >= stepAtFrame ? stepUs : 0); signed truncation is toward zero
seriesGrammar.jitter: state starts at jitterSeed; before EVERY frame state = uint32(state*1664525 + 1013904223); jitterUs = uint64(state) % (jitterAmplitudeUs+1)
seriesGrammar.anchor: anchorUs = trunc((sourceUs + truth + jitterUs)/anchorResolutionUs)*anchorResolutionUs; nonnegative inputs only
seriesGrammar.error: abs(mapped baseUs - sourceUs(global series) - truth); measured from errorCheckAfterFrame, plus settledAfterFrame when nonzero. This oracle stays meaningful after mapper sourceUs re-anchors. Re-anchoring can change integer source conversion phase by 1 us; step cases explicitly allow that 1 us.
seriesGrammar.rewarms: count every mapper epoch change after construction; require clock_mapping_unstable on each change and exact expectedFirstRewarmFrame (0 if none)
seriesGrammar.defaults: ReplaySeries fields/defaults in deck_source_clock_mapper_test.cpp; all cases below explicitly specify every generation field and error/re-warm bound; platform implementations consume this JSON, never C++ output as their oracle
